verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents an official MCP server for Cloud Run on its own docs site and publishes it in the GoogleCloudPlatform GitHub org. It also ships MCP Toolbox for Databases, an open-source MCP server from the googleapis org that explicitly lets Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and other MCP clients connect agents to databases. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, documented setup/auth detail for the Cloud Run MCP server, and evidence of MCP coverage beyond Cloud Run and databases.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: An MCP server which operates on Cloud Run resources.
MCP server to deploy apps to Cloud Run
MCP Toolbox for Databases is an open source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects your AI agents, IDEs, and applications directly to your enterprise databases.
Instantly connect Gemini CLI, Google Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, or other MCP clients to your databases
